description: This file is a React-like component written in TypeScript for a notes application frontend. It manages state for notes, categories, and UI elements, and renders the main application shell including header, sidebar, note list, and note editor. It interacts with backend services for CRUD operations on notes and categories.

methods.name: deriveCategories
methods.description: Helper function to derive categories from a list of notes, including counting notes per category, and an 'Uncategorized' entry.
